Furthermore, the following episode "[[Victory and Death]]" takes place immediately afterwards, and demonstrates that there were no survivors aboard the ''[[Tribunal]]'' when it crashed. Since Ridge was onboard the Star Destroyer, Ridge must have died as well. aboard the ''[[Tribunal]]''{{TCW|Victory and Death}}''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Character Encyclopedia - Join the Battle!]]'' |species=[[Human]] {{C|[[Cloning|clone]]}} |gender= |pronouns= |donor=[[Jango Fett]] |height=1.83 [[meter]]s |mass= |hair= |feathers= |eyes= |skin= |cyber= |families= |parents= |partners= |siblings= |children= |affiliation=*[[Galactic Republic]][[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]] **[[501st Legion]] |masters= |apprentices= }} {{Quote|Ridge is down! Maul's advancing toward the main hangar!|A clone trooper reports to Commander Rex|{{TCW|Shattered}}}} '''Ridge''' was a [[clone trooper]] who served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars]] as a part of the [[501st Legion]]. They first served in the [[legion]]'s [[Torrent Company]] during the [[Battle of Teth]] under [[Clone Captain]] [[Rex]], one of the earlier conflicts of the war, and later served in the [[332nd Company]] of the legion's [[332nd Division|new division]] by the end of the war. Following the [[Siege of Mandalore]] that resulted in the capture of renegade [[Sith Lord]] [[Maul]], Ridge participated in the [[Skirmish aboard the Tribunal|implementation]] of [[Order 66]] against [[Ahsoka Tano]] aboard the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Tribunal]]'', and was killed when they and their fellow [[trooper]]s encountered Maul. After Ridge was incapacitated, another [[Cloning|clone]] trooper reported to Rex, now a [[Clone Commander]], that Ridge was down and that Maul was moving toward the main [[hangar]]. ==Biography== ===Battle of Teth=== {{Quote|Ridge, your comm's got static.''"
"''Got it.|A clone trooper and Ridge, before the Battle of Teth|audio=RidgeStatic-TCWf.flac|}} [[File:Confederate_counterassault.png|thumb|left|280px|Ridge participated in the Battle of Teth as part of the 501st Legion's Torrent Company.]] Ridge was a [[clone trooper]] that was grown on the [[planet]] [[Kamino]] from the [[DNA]] of [[Jango Fett]], a [[bounty hunter]] who became the [[Clone template|template]] of the [[Cloning|clone]] [[trooper]] [[army]].{{Film|II}} Ridge served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatist Alliance]], and belonged to [[Torrent Company]] of the [[501st Legion]]. After [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure]]'s son, [[Rotta]], was kidnapped by alleged [[bounty]] [[Hunting|hunters]], Ridge and their unit were dispatched to the planet [[Teth]] in [[22 BBY]]''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' places the [[Battle of Christophsis]] and the [[Mission to Rodia]] to [[22 BBY]]. Since the [[Battle of Teth]] takes place directly afterward the Battle of [[Christophsis]] and prior to the Mission to [[Rodia]], the Battle of [[Teth]] must have also taken place in the same [[Standard year|year]]. in order to rescue him. Ridge was onboard the same [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry|LAAT/i gunship]] that carried [[Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker]], [[Jedi Commander]] [[Ahsoka Tano]], and [[Clone Captain]] [[Rex]] to the [[B'omarr Order Monastery]] where Rotta was suspected to be held captive. Falling under attack by Separatist forces on the monastery, the [[Battle of Teth]] commenced and the [[gunship]]s came under heavy fire. During the landing, a clone trooper informed Ridge that their [[comlink]] had static, which Ridge quickly acknowledged and repaired by knocking on their [[helmet]]. Republic forces soon landed and scaled up the monastery's rock wall until they managed to reach the structure itself. There, they managed to locate and rescue Rotta, but not before Separatist reinforcements trapped them on the monastery. Forced inside the building, Torrent [[Company]] suffered heavy casualties and eventually were captured and taken [[prisoner]]. It wasn't until [[Jedi]] [[General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and the [[7th Sky Corps]] arrived to reinforce Torrent Company that [[Captain]] Rex and his forces were able to fight off the [[droid]] forces. Eventually through the course of the battle, only a few survivors remained of Torrent Company. ===Mandalore and Order 66=== {{Quote|All right. We know Ahsoka Tano is onboard. She's been marked for termination by Order 66.|Commander Rex, to members of his unit during the implementation of Order 66|}} [[File:Siege_of_Mandalore_rages.png|thumb|right|300px|As part of the 501st's 332nd Company, Ridge participated in the Siege of Mandalore, which engulfed the city of Sundari.]] In [[19 BBY]], by the [[time]] of the [[Outer Rim Sieges]] at the tail end of the Clone Wars, Ridge was reassigned to the [[332nd Company]], a company within the newly created [[332nd Division]] of the 501st Legion. When former Jedi Ahsoka Tano returned and met with her former teacher and friend Anakin Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi to discuss a joint operation between the Republic and the [[Mandalore resistance]],{{TCW|Old Friends Not Forgotten}} Ridge was one of many clone troopers who customized their helmets in a stylized version of Tano's face and markings. Captain Rex was promoted to the [[military rank]] of [[Clone Commander]], and along with Tano as an [[advisor]], led Republic forces in the [[Siege of Mandalore]] against renegade [[Sith Lord]] [[Maul]] and the [[Shadow Collective]], which controlled the planet from the [[city]] of [[Sundari]]. After the Shadow Collective was defeated and Maul was captured, Ridge was among the remainder of 501st Legion forces that departed Mandalore aboard the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Tribunal]]'', which was transporting Maul to [[Coruscant]]. As the [[Star Destroyer]] was en route, Republic [[Supreme Chancellor]] Sheev Palpatine, secretly the [[Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Sidious]], enacted [[Order 66]], a clone protocol that established all members of the Jedi as [[Treason|traitors]] to the Galactic Republic. After Rex, [[Advanced Recon Commando]] [[Jesse|CT-5597]] "Jesse," and members of the 501st and [[Coruscant Guard]] [[Skirmish aboard the Tribunal|ambushed]] Tano on the [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]], Tano managed to escape and reached Maul, who was being held captive in a holding cell inside a [[Mandalorian vault]]. Needing a distraction, Tano freed Maul and parted ways with the intention that Maul would shift attention away from her. As Tano sought for answers and a way to stop Rex and remove him from his trance, Maul made his way to the main [[hangar]] of the [[Star Destroyer]] and left a path of destruction in his wake. Encountering 501st clone troopers and [[Imperial shock trooper|clone shock troopers]], Maul used pieces of the hallways as [[Shield (physical armor)|shields]] and as weapons with [[the Force]]. [[File:Ridge_death.png|thumb|left|260px|Ridge and another clone trooper, shortly prior to their incapacitation at the hands of Maul.]] Ridge and a contingent of clone troopers confronted Maul but began to retreat, as the [[Sith]] [[Lord]] was too powerful for them. Using a piece of metal from the hallway, Maul threw the metal and decapitated several clones in front of Ridge. Maul then used another piece of metal and [[Force push]]ed it into Ridge and another clone, impaling one and pinning them against the wall, and knocking the other to the ground. After the two were incapacitated, one of the three remaining clones contacted [[Commander]] Rex that Ridge was down, and that Maul was heading towards the hangar. After Rex gave them orders, the three clones escaped, although one had their [[limb]] amputated by Maul when he used the Force to hold him back as the doors of the hallway closed. While Maul escaped, he utilized the Force to destroy the ship's [[reactor]] and [[hyperdrive]], causing the vessel to exit [[hyperspace]] in a deteriorated state as it began to rapidly descend on a [[Unidentified moon|moon]]. After firefighting took place in the ship's main hangar between the 501st, Maul, and Tano along with Rex, who had his [[Behavioral modification biochip|inhibitor chip]] removed, the ''Tribunal'' crashed on the surface, killing all onboard. The only survivors were Maul, who escaped via a [[Nu-class attack/transport shuttle|''Nu''-class attack/transport shuttle]], and Tano and Rex, who survived by taking control of a [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/bomber]]. In the aftermath, Tano and Rex were at the ship's crash site, with Rex gathering supplies and Tano burying the dead clones, using their helmets on poles as memorials. ==Personality and traits== As a clone of Jango Fett, Ridge was a [[human]] who stood at 1.83 [[meter]]s. When Order 66 was enacted, Ridge did not disobey the command. Even as their comrades nearby were killed in various ways, including decapitation, Ridge continued to fire their weapon. ==Skills and abilities== As a clone trooper, Ridge was trained in combat and built to withstand battle stress.{{TCW|The Unknown}} establishes that clone troopers were built to withstand any combat stress. For instance, when their comlink had static, Ridge was able to quickly fix the issue. Ridge served in multiple battles throughout the war, including at one of the first engagements of the war at Teth and one of the last at Mandalore. After the activation of Order 66, Ridge and their fellow clone troopers hunted down Tano onboard the ship until she escaped and released Maul. As the clones rushed to combat him, Ridge bravely stood their ground against a far superior opponent as they tried to fight off the former Sith. ==Equipment== Ridge was equipped with standard white [[Phase I clone trooper armor]] when he was a member of Torrent Company early in the Clone Wars. Toward the end of the war, Ridge was equipped with [[Phase II clone trooper armor]] in the blue markings of the 501st Legion, although Ridge later customized their [[armor]] set's helmet in orange-red coloring with the pattern reflecting a stylized version of Ahsoka Tano's face and facial markings, after they were reassigned to the [[332nd Division]]. During combat, Ridge used a [[DC-15A blaster carbine]]. ==Behind the scenes== Ridge first appeared in the animated theatrical film [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'']] which was released on [[August 15]], [[2008]] in the United States{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/news/announcement.html|text=''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' In Theaters and on Television in 2008}} and was directed by [[Dave Filoni]]. Ridge, like all clone troopers in in the film and in [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|the TV series]], was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]]. Following his appearance in the film, Ridge was not featured in the show until the [[The Clone Wars: Season Seven|seventh and final season]] episode "[[Shattered]]," the penultimate of the series. This differs from [[Ridge/Legends|Ridge's]] fate in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where the trooper was implied to have died during the events of the film.[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' novelization]] ==Appearances== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Ridge}} *[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]] {{1st}} *{{TCW|Shattered}} *{{TBB|Extraction}} {{Imo}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Ridge |fr=Ridge |ja=リッジ |ka=რიჯი }} [[Category:Clone troopers]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]] [[Category:Members of the 501st Legion (Galactic Republic)]] [[Category:Members of Torrent Company]]
